Fizzy Pink
By: Wendi Spraker
Published: Thursday, May 28, 2015 - 1:04pm

Ingredients




1 oz Lime flavored Gin
½ Cup Ginger Ale
¼ Cup Cranberry Juice
Lime slice for garnish
Sugar for glass rim

Preparation

1 Wet the rim of the glass with the lime slice and then sugar the rim of the glass by dipping it in sugar that is poured out into a flat saucer. 2 Combine all ingredients and pour over ice into sugared rim glass 3 Garnish with lime slice

About

This light and refreshing drink will become the highlight of your summer - try one today!
